<p dir="auto">AI engineers today face three problems of building agents:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Prompt Hell</strong>: Hours of prompt tweaking and trial-and-error frustration.</li>
<li><strong>Workflow Blindspots</strong>: Lack of visibility into step interactions causing hidden failures and confusion.</li>
<li><strong>Terminal Testing Nightmare</strong> Squinting at raw outputs and manually parsing JSON.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">We've been there ourselves, too. We launched a graphic design agent early 2024 and quickly reached thousands of users, yet, struggled with the lack of its reliability and existing debugging tools.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">✨ Core features:</h1><a id="user-content--core-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ✨ Core features:" href="#-core-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>👤 <strong>Human in the Loop</strong>: Persistent workflows that wait for human approval.</li>
<li>🔄 <strong>Loops</strong>: Iterative tool calling with memory.</li>
<li>📤 <strong>File Upload</strong>: Upload files or paste URLs to process documents.</li>
<li>📋 <strong>Structured Outputs</strong>: UI editor for JSON Schemas.</li>
<li>🗃️ <strong>RAG</strong>: Parse, Chunk, Embed, and Upsert Data into a Vector DB.</li>
<li>🖼️ <strong>Multimodal</strong>: Support for Video, Images, Audio, Texts, Code.</li>
<li>🧰 <strong>Tools</strong>: Slack, Firecrawl.dev, Google Sheets, GitHub, and more.</li>
<li>📊 <strong>Traces</strong>: Automatically capture execution traces of deployed agents.</li>
<li>🧪 <strong>Evals</strong>: Evaluate agents on real-world datasets.</li>
<li>🚀 <strong>One-Click Deploy</strong>: Publish as an API and integrate wherever you want.</li>
<li>🐍 <strong>Python-Based</strong>: Add new nodes by creating a single Python file.</li>
<li>🎛️ <strong>Any-Vendor-Support</strong>: >100 LLM providers, embedders, and vector DBs.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">⚡ Quick start</h1><a id="user-content--quick-start" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ⚡ Quick start" href="#-quick-start"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">This is the quickest way to get started. Python 3.11 or higher is required.</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Install PySpur:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pip install pyspur"><pre>pip install pyspur</pre></div>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Initialize a new project:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pyspur init my-project
cd my-project"><pre>pyspur init my-project
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> my-project</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">This will create a new directory with a <code>.env</code> file.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Start the server:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pyspur serve --sqlite"><pre>pyspur serve --sqlite</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">By default, this will start PySpur app at <code>http://localhost:6080</code> using a sqlite database.
We recommend you configure a postgres instance URL in the <code>.env</code> file to get a more stable experience.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>[Optional] Configure Your Environment and Add API Keys:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>App UI</strong>: Navigate to API Keys tab to add provider keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)</li>
<li><strong>Manual</strong>: Edit <code>.env</code> file (recommended: configure postgres) and restart with <code>pyspur serve</code></li>
</ul>
